source_review.locator: Section2.1.2/Figure3 for core definitions/depths; Section2.3 for approximate source areas/path length and separate idealized box.

assumptions: Use only same1993–2022 mean AW velocity-ranked half-transport cores at Gimsøy and Bjørnøya. BSO has a different salinity-ranked core and is excluded.
Treat the approximate source750km path as an abstract interpolation coordinate. No map geometry, exact station/core longitude or current-axis trajectory is supplied.
Assume linear maximum-mask-depth and source-area changes between sections. Preserve source approximate areas8/17km2 and depth maxima530/580m.

For regional extrusion, assume source section areas are normal to the abstract path; no orientation correction is recovered. Source rectangular midpoint cells slightly overestimate area by ignoring bathymetric cell cuts.
Integrate source areas directly.50m top exclusion is not a physical upper flow boundary, and source50km box width/200m box depth/7500km3 box volume are not actual mask geometry or uncertainty bounds.

This broad source NwASC continuation may overlap modern West Spitsbergen naming. No whole-current scalar, independent component sum, instantaneous mean volume, seasonal extrema or global total is established.
